reason: A code-reuse and architecture-analysis plugin that searches configured local code and optional public repositories, evaluates reuse versus rewriting, and presents candidates for user selection.

summaries.zh: 在开发前检索本地代码库及可选的开源平台，分析代码或系统架构的复用候选与成本权衡，并交由用户决定是否采用。
summaries.en: Searches configured local codebases and optional open-source platforms before development, evaluates code or architecture reuse tradeoffs, and presents candidates for the user to choose.

capabilities: Scans configured local directories for reusable code and system architecture signals
Queries GitHub, GitLab, Gitee, and npm for reference projects or packages when remote search is enabled
Reads repository metadata, licenses, and README content from remote results
Presents reuse candidates and cost or compatibility assessments for user selection
May place matched paths, short code excerpts, and architecture profiles into the agent context
